summary.text: You can request a change within 30 days of your first policy letter. Some changes are allowed later.

details.heading: Within 30 days
details.body: Write to CPF to request a change within 30 days of the date on your first policy letter.

details.heading: Changes after 30 days
details.body: Some changes may still be allowed. Original or Standard Plan members may change to the Escalating Plan if they are concerned about their retirement lifestyle as prices rise. Other concessions also apply.

details.heading: Changing is permanent
details.body: Consider your options carefully before changing your plan. The change cannot be reversed.

example_phrasings: Can I change my plan type after I have joined CPF LIFE?
Can I switch my CPF LIFE plan later?
